Run MOIRe MCMC analysis

Source: R/moire_wrapper.R
run_moire.Rd

Runs MOIRe MCMC on a prepared moire_object. Requires moire (Suggests). For reading allele tables and writing summary TSVs, use moire_wrapper().

Usage

run_moire(moire_object)

Arguments

moire_object

List with moire_data and moire_parameters. See Inputs.

Value

The object returned by moire::run_mcmc().

Details

Inputs

  • moire_object: List with moire_data and moire_parameters, as created by create_moire_input() (via moire_wrapper()).

Outputs

  • Returns the object from moire::run_mcmc() (not written to disk).

Running

run_moire(moire_object)

File and CLI users should call moire_wrapper() / Rscript exec/moire_wrapper ....

Requires moire (Suggests).

See also

moire_wrapper(), vignette("input-formats", package = "PGEcore")
